ideas.title: The 3AM Email That Closed a $12K Deal
ideas.concept: A behind-the-scenes breakdown of an N8N workflow connected to Claude AI and GoHighLevel that qualifies leads, drafts personalised replies, and books calls while the business owner sleeps. Visual would show a split screen: Alfie sleeping on one side, a glowing dashboard with notifications firing on the other.
ideas.hook: While you were sleeping, this workflow made me $12K. Here's exactly how it's built.

ideas.title: Stop Hiring. Start Automating.
ideas.concept: A direct-to-camera or text-overlay post calling out business owners who keep throwing humans at problems software should solve. Show a side-by-side: a $4K/month VA vs. a Claude + Google Workspace + N8N stack doing the same job for £80/month. Hard numbers, no fluff.
ideas.hook: Your next hire shouldn't be a person. It should be a workflow.

ideas.title: The 5-Tool Stack Running My Entire Business
ideas.concept: A carousel or short-form video revealing the exact tools Accelod uses to run client delivery, sales, and ops: Claude AI for thinking, N8N for connecting, GoHighLevel for selling, Google Workspace for everything else. Each slide shows one tool and the specific job it does, ending with a CTA to book a free automation audit.
ideas.hook: I run a consultancy with 4 tools and zero employees. Here's the stack.
